issue_context.title: Create HPA ContainerResource E2E Test
issue_context.body:
#### What would you like to be added:

We need an E2E test for HPA [ContainerResource](https://pkg.go.dev/k8s.io/api/autoscaling/v2beta2#ContainerResourceMetricSource) targets.

#### Why is this needed:

HPA v2beta2 is graduating to stable!

KEP: https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-autoscaling/2702-graduate-hpa-api-to-GA
Tracking issue: kubernetes/enhancements#2702
Working doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QGT9Waxc500ICGX_TGIoxfOWKmWbXYC6TWxfdUC2Njg/edit#
Slack channel: #sig-autoscaling-api

#### What to do:

1. Read [End-to-End Testing in Kubernetes](https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/master/contributors/devel/sig-testing/e2e-tests.md).
2. Tell @josephburnett on #sig-autoscaling-api "Hey, I want to do this." (just so two people don't start the same work)
3. Write a new E2E test that tests `spec.metrics[{type:ContainerResource}]`.

#### Details:

There are currently two kinds of HPA tests in the Kubernetes E2E suite.  One tests [CPU autoscaling](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/c495744436fc94ebbef2fcbeb97699ca96fe02dd/test/e2e/autoscaling/horizontal_pod_autoscaling.go#L31) and the other tests [custom metrics autoscaling](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/c495744436fc94ebbef2fcbeb97699ca96fe02dd/test/e2e/autoscaling/custom_metrics_stackdriver_autoscaling.go#L48).

Container resource targets are a new feature which allows users to specify a single container within the pod who CPU or memory utilization should be taken into account for scaling.  This prevent injected sidecars and other, idle containers from skewing the application metrics higher or lower.  They of course can be used in conjunction with (pod) resource metrics from which the HPA will select the highest recommendation.

The new container resource E2E tests should go in the CPU autoscaling suite.  The resource consuming workload will probably need to be modified to setup a container resource target use case.

Cases we should test:
1. Scale up on a busy application with an idle sidecar container.  We should scale higher than we would have with a whole pod resource target because we remove the sidecar from the picture.
2. Do not scale up on a busy sidecar with an idle application.  We should not react to containers which we are not targeting.

Send a pull request (one squashed commit please) and notify #sig-autoscaling-api so we can take a look too. It will probably need API review.

Feel free to reach out for help on #sig-autoscaling-api if you have any questions!

review_comments: Can you show me the math for why 5 is the correct result?  I would expect half of the `perPodCPURequest` to go to the sidecar (even split) and the load to be placed entirely on the non-sidecar container.  So somehow the load + the 250m CPU request should ==> 5 replicas.  Right?
If I understand this correct, the parameter `scaleTest.perPodCPURequest` is used for both the resource consumer and the busy or idle sidecar.  So it's actually `perContainerCPURequest`.
I will update the field name in the struct.
